map.按基本锚固长度公式由钢筋与混凝土强度计算锚固长度。: Anchorage length from the basic formula using the reinforcement and concrete strengths.
map.l_a = ζ·l_ab，按锚固区保护层等修正: l_a = ζ·l_ab, corrected for cover in the anchorage zone and other factors
map.l_ab = α·ζ_a·(f_y/f_t)·d，α=0.14（带肋钢筋外形系数: l_ab = α·ζ_a·(f_y/f_t)·d, with α = 0.14 (the profile coefficient for deformed bars)
map.d>25mm 时 ζ_a 取 1.1，环氧涂层钢筋取 1.25 等: Take ζ_a = 1.1 when d > 25 mm and 1.25 for epoxy-coated bars, etc.
map.受拉锚固长度 l_a = ζ·l_ab，按锚固区保护层等修正: Tension anchorage length l_a = ζ·l_ab, corrected for cover in the anchorage zone and other factors
map.📚 深度解析：钢筋锚固长度计算（土木）: 📚 In-depth analysis: rebar anchorage length calculation (civil)
map.梁柱节点锚固：纵筋伸入支座长度≥laE，直锚不足时弯锚或机械锚固。: Beam-column joint anchorage: the longitudinal bars extend into the support by at least laE, and where a straight anchorage is insufficient, use a hooked or mechanical anchorage.
map.修订正系数：带肋钢筋、保护层厚、横向钢筋多时可折减 la。: Revisions to the coefficient: deformed bars, thick cover and closely spaced transverse steel allow l_a to be reduced.
map.机械/焊接锚固：替代弯钩减小节点拥挤，按等效锚固长度校核。: Mechanical or welded anchorage: replaces hooks to reduce joint congestion and is checked against the equivalent anchorage length.
map.d=20mm、C30（ft=1.43）、HRB400（fy=360）、带肋 α=: With d = 20 mm, C30 (f_t = 1.43), HRB400 (f_y = 360) and α = 0.14: l_a = α·(f_y/f_t)·d = 0.14 × (360/1.43) × 20 ≈ 705 mm. For seismic design l_aE = ζaE·l_a (with ζaE = 1.15 for seismic grades one and two) ≈ 811 mm.
map.抗震锚固 laE 为何更长？: Why is the seismic anchorage l_aE longer?
Seismic design requires that bars in the plastic hinge region do not slip under repeated loading, so l_a is multiplied by ζaE (1.15 for grades one and two, 1.05 for grade three) to make anchorage more reliable.
map.哪些情况可折减 la？: Which cases allow l_a to be reduced?
map.锚固区有箍筋、保护层厚、带肋钢筋、预应力等可乘小于 1 的修正系数；但直锚不足仍: Stirrups in the anchorage zone, thick cover, deformed bars and prestressing all allow a correction factor below 1. Even so, if the straight anchorage is insufficient you must use a hooked or mechanical anchorage.
map.机械锚固算够吗？: Is mechanical anchorage enough on its own?
map.端头焊锚板/弯钩等效投影锚固长度≥0.6la 并满足构造即认可，能缩短锚固节省节: End plates welded to the bar, hooks and similar details with an equivalent projected anchorage length of at least 0.6l_a that meet the detailing requirements are accepted. This shortens anchorage and saves joint space, but follow the standard atlas.
